register_hydra_resolvers: register all custom Hydra resolvers for torch_dtype, fsdp_param_strategy, and weight_decay_type in OmegaConf
resolve_torch_dtype: resolve a string like float32 or bfloat16 to its corresponding torch.dtype value
resolve_fsdp_param_strategy: resolve a string to an FSDPParamAssignmentStrategy enum from distributed_shampoo
resolve_weight_decay_type: resolve a string to a WeightDecayType enum from distributed_shampoo
review_resolver_functions: review the Hydra resolver functions for torch dtype, FSDP strategy, and weight decay type resolution
